title: Make New World the default theme every new Space starts in, with the first-selection picker

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: New World is the new mega template, default theme for every new Space

detail: New Spaces start on New World; the picker (LIVE-2043) lets them choose Kit, Accent, Register and Look first. Existing Spaces keep their theme. Never offered in a way that restyles a member or console area. 2026-11-03 prerequisite found by a full vitest run with DEFAULT_SITE_THEME flipped to new-world: 16 pinned tests fail beyond the picker pins (site-style.test.ts 6, email-colors.test.ts 5, style-action.test.ts 1, surface.test.ts 1, spotlight-surface.test.ts 1, backlog-contract.test.ts 2). The email-colors ones need real New World email defaults first (LIVE-2057 email types), so this row waits on them and then re-runs the pin list for the owner's phrases. Un-hiding the picker alone is LIVE-2059 and needs only two pin rewrites plus the /themes/new-world page.
